active_location.macro_silhouette: The obsidian-black shores of the ferrofluid sea stretch out, rippling with sharp magnetic waves under a copper sky. Giant fractal spires of magnetized iron rise sporadically, their geometric edges catching the dim light. The horizon is distorted by the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear, twisting the boundary between the heavy fluid and the dense spore-fog.

sensory_palette.sound: A deep, resonant hum of magnetic resistance overlaid with the sharp crackle of static discharge.
sensory_palette.smell: Ozone, rusted iron, and a faint, acrid tang of charged spores.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: A prickly, vibrating chill that makes the hair on your arms stand up and teeth ache slightly.
sensory_palette.taste_optional: A distinct metallic tang on the back of the tongue.
